Baron Kepmak

Medium Humanoid (Lizardfolk), Chaotic Evil
Saving ThrowsCon +4, Wis +2
SkillsPerception +4, Stealth +5, Survival +4
Sensespassive Perception 14
LanguagesAbyssal, Draconic
Challenge4 (1,100 XP)
Traits
Hold Breath.

Kepmak can hold his breath for 15 minutes.

Skewer.

Once on each of Kepmak's turns, when he makes a melee attack with his Trident and hits a creature, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage, and Kepmak gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the extra damage dealt.

Actions
Multiattack.

Kepmak makes two attacks: one Bite attack and one Claws or Trident attack.

Bite.

Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

Claws.

Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage.

Trident.

Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
